svg.aria-label: Flowcast (lloydaq/flowcast). Traffic speed forecasting for 207 Los Angeles highway sensors (METR-LA), 15–60 min ahead. Leakage-tested features, baselines, LightGBM and a DCRNN graph network, compared on identical rows with bootstrap significance. FastAPI backend and a React dashboard that replays June 2012: each forecast shown against what actually happened.
